proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width strip immediately after main content and before the cookie overlay, containing an identical tagline ("The best no-code platform for ...") plus a row of partner-logo placeholders (rendered as bare "| |" text), appearing on every page with identical content.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a global footer/CTA fragment excluded from per-page block inventory, mirroring how the announcement bar and cookie overlay are treated as site chrome. Alternative rejected: modeling it as a per-page 'logo-strip' block via repeating-cards-are-one-block, since content is identical across pages, not page-specific.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text and structure recur unchanged across all sampled pages; it is site-wide chrome, not authorable page content.

provenance.evidence: C147 rc3c1c1/rc3c1c2 identical across C147-C154 packets

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] answer node appears a second time as a top-level page sibling (outside the FAQ accordion container) with text duplicating an answer already nested inside the accordion.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude the duplicate top-level region from the block inventory; the content is already captured inside the faq-accordion block's nested rows.
proposed_rules.rationale: Absolute-positioned/expanded accordion answer panels get promoted out of their DOM parent by the capture tool, producing duplicate top-level nodes that are a capture artifact, not real page content.

provenance.evidence: C147 rc4/rc5 duplicate 'Backups are designed...' and 'Long-term healthcare data...' also present nested under rc2c9c2

notes: Standard Knack Health solution-page template: hero, alternating text sections, one use-case card grid, CTA banner, FAQ accordion, footer tagline strip, cookie overlay.
